name: display_mode
label: Display Mode
help_text: Use 'Content only' in the left column. Place a second instance below the layout set to 'Testimonials only' for the full-width testimonials row.

name: benefits_heading
label: Benefits Card Heading
help_text: Heading inside the membership benefits card.

name: heading_level
label: Heading Level
help_text: Controls the HTML heading tag for the main benefits heading. Use H1 only once per page for the main title.

name: benefits_description
label: Benefits Card Description
help_text: Description text inside the benefits card.
default: IPS Partners VIPSCLUB gives you access to exclusive services, rewards, and a growing network of like-minded members.

name: benefits
label: Benefits List
help_text: Checkmarked benefit items shown in the benefits card.

children.name: check_icon
children.label: Check Icon
children.help_text: Checkmark icon for this benefit. Upload SVG/PNG or paste raw SVG code. Leave empty to use default green checkmark.

children.name: image
children.label: Upload Icon (SVG or PNG)
children.help_text: Upload from Files Manager. Recommended: 15x15px SVG.

children.name: svg_code
children.label: Or: Paste SVG Code
children.help_text: Paste raw SVG code. Leave empty to use the default green checkmark.

children.name: benefit_title
children.label: Benefit Title
children.default: Earn points on every completed service

children.name: benefit_desc
children.label: Benefit Description
children.help_text: Short description shown below the title.
children.default: Redeem toward free services and vouchers

name: steps_heading
label: Steps Section Heading
help_text: Heading shown above the steps card.
default: Four steps to your first reward

name: steps_description
label: Steps Section Description
help_text: Text shown below the steps heading.
default: Sign up, get your tier, use our services, and earn points you can spend on things that matter.

name: steps
label: Steps
help_text: The four steps shown in the steps card.

children.name: step_desc
children.label: Step Description
children.help_text: Short description below the step title.
children.default: Create your free VIPSCLUB account in under 2 minutes

children.name: is_highlight
children.label: Highlight (Red Number)
children.help_text: When enabled, the step number displays in red to draw attention.

name: testimonials_heading
label: Testimonials Section Heading
help_text: Heading shown above the testimonials grid.

name: testimonials_description
label: Testimonials Section Description
help_text: Description shown below the testimonials heading.
default: Real feedback from people already using VIPSCLUB.

name: testimonials
label: Testimonials
help_text: Testimonial cards shown in a 3-column grid.

children.name: quote
children.label: Quote Text
children.default: I referred two colleagues and earned enough points to redeem a free service consultation.

children.name: reviewer_meta
children.label: Reviewer Meta
children.help_text: Sub-line shown below the reviewer name (e.g. 'Silver member • 3 referrals').

children.name: background_color
children.label: Background Color
children.help_text: Leave empty to use theme default

children.name: padding_top
children.label: Padding Top (px)
children.help_text: Leave empty to use default spacing

children.name: padding_bottom
children.label: Padding Bottom (px)
children.help_text: Leave empty to use default spacing

children.name: text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Override the default text color for this module instance. Leave empty for theme default.

children.name: content_width
children.label: Content Width
children.help_text: Control the maximum width of this module's content.

children.name: hide_on_desktop
children.label: Hide on Desktop
children.help_text: Toggle to hide this module on desktop viewports.
